sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Vacillating; pleasant mania; sings and
laughs. Happy and affectionate ; then angry. Sudden
changes from hilarity to melancholy. Vivid recollec-
tion from music heard. [Lyc.]

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Throbs, pulsates, during climacteric ; worse
during menses.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Appearance as of electric sparks. Must wipe
eyes as if mucus or W'ater were in them. Feeling in
eyes as after violent weeping. Sensation as if she had
been looking through too sharp spectacles. Eyes feel

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Obstinate constipation due to portal stag-
nation. Constipation in infants. Crawling and stitches
in anus. Sensation of something alive in abdomen,
stomach, etc., especially on left side. [Calend.]

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Sensation of something alive and moving in
stomach and in the abdomen, which is swollen, or of
something dead and heavy. Threatened abortion, es-
pecially when haemorrhage is dark and stringy. Urg-
ing of blood to genitals. Menses dark, viscid, too fre-
Quent and copious, black and slimy. Uterine haemor-
rhage; clots with long strings; worse from least move-
ment. Jerking pain in interior of left breast, as if
drawn toward back by means of thread. [Crot. fig.]
A bounding feeling, as if something alive in right
breast.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Wheezy cougn, with frothy expectora-
tion, containing threads like fine twine; worse, lying
down. Breath has offensive, sickly smell. Feeling as
if the uvula is elongated in hysterical patients.

Haemorrhages. — Dark, stringy, clotted. Epistaxis;
strings of dark blood hanging down the nose. Bloody

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Sudden feeling of coldness in back as if cold
water were thrown over him; icy- cold extremities.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Spasmodic contractions and twitchings
of single set of muscles. Chorea and hysteria, with
great alterations of feeling. Whole upper extremity
falls asleep.

280

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, lying down, hot weather, warm
room, in morning, fasting, before breakfast, looking
fixedly at an object. Better, in open air.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: Opium; Bell.

Compare: I pec.; Trillium; Plat.; China; Sabina.
